inject.title: How We Sell a WordPress Theme With a Stripe Payment Link
inject.core_topic: We sell a paid WordPress theme with a Stripe Payment Link, a static thank-you page and one serverless function that verifies the payment before serving the zip, with no store plugin.
x:
We sell a WordPress theme without a store plugin or a license server.

A Stripe Payment Link, a static thank-you page, and one small serverless function.
The function asks Stripe two things: is this session paid, and did it come from our payment link? Only then does it stream the zip from a private GitHub release.

The mistake it avoids: our site's code is in a public repo. A paid zip at a secret path there would have been free to anyone who looked.

https://switchcasestudio.com/blog/selling-a-wordpress-theme-with-a-stripe-payment-link
